text:
Tom R.: Hey folks — we're chartering a shuttle for ~12 people for the summit next week. Vendor sent a single invoice in EUR. How should we handle expenses? Can one person submit and everyone allocate to their cost centers, or does everyone need separate receipts?

Aditi (People Ops): Short answer: one invoice is fine. Submit on behalf of the group with an attendee list + proof of payment. In the expense form select `Travel - Ground Transport` and use the split allocation feature to apportion across cost centers. Make sure the uploaded invoice is itemized and shows VAT (or explicitly says no VAT).

Finance Bot: GL note: use code `GRT-TRAVEL`. If reimbursing a payer, attach the bank/cc statement showing the charge. VAT reclaimability depends on vendor country — attach the vendor invoice so Finance can assess. If you're using a PO or preapproval, attach that too.

Jordan K.: Follow-up — what if several attendees paid their portion on personal cards but vendor only produced a single invoice? What's acceptable evidence for each person's share?

Aditi (People Ops): If multiple personal cards were used, preferred workflow is: ask vendor for an itemized invoice that lists attendee names and amounts. If vendor cannot split, have a single payer upload the invoice + bank statement + a short attestation in the expense description listing attendees and amounts, e.g. `I, Tom R., paid full invoice €1200 on 2026-07-02; please reimburse €100 each to attendees listed`. Then each attendee files an expense for their share (attach the payer's invoice + attestation) and selects `Reimbursable expense - cost split`. That gives Finance the paper trail we need.

Luca M.: Just to confirm, this doesn't affect per diem rules right? Bus = transport, not meals.

Finance Bot: Correct — transport only. For currency: upload the invoice in original currency; the expense system will convert. If you want manual override, include the exchange rate screenshot. For VAT: if invoice shows VAT and it's reclaimable we will claim it; if not, we expense gross. Please add `event:summit-2026` in the notes for easier tracking.

Aditi (People Ops): Quick checklist before you submit: 1) itemized invoice (required), 2) proof of payment (bank/cc statement), 3) attendee list with names/emails, 4) cost allocation split in the expense fields, 5) manager approval or PO number, 6) attestation if one person paid. If vendor is a US gov entity or a charter operator, ping us first — slightly different rules there. :thumbsup:

Tom R.: Great — I'll gather the invoice and payment proof and submit on behalf of the group. I'll cc @Aditi (People Ops) and attach the attendee list. Thanks! :white_check_mark:

Finance Bot: Noted. GL: `GRT-TRAVEL`. Finance will review after submission and follow up if VAT details are missing.
